title: Vinquibus
extract:
Vinquibus is  Uriel's Signature Weapon that functions as both a primary semi-automatic rifle and a melee bayonet weapon.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Equipping Vinquibus will occupy both primary and melee weapon slots.
Both forms gain an equal amount of Affinity and will thus rank up evenly.
Vinquibus is counted as a single weapon in regards to earning Mastery Rank.
Primary and melee forms are modded separately, using rifle and melee mods respectively.
Riven Mods for primary and melee forms are generated separately.
 Orokin Catalyst, Focus Lens,  Exilus Weapon Adapter, and  Forma/Polarization are applied to both forms.
Does not appear as an available loadout option in Deep Archimedea/Temporal Archimedea or Duviri.
Innate one  and one  polarities.
Primary
Headshots grant 2 stacks (max 16) of the Vinquibus Precision buff, increasing melee damage by 250%.
Stacks are indicated on the right side of the reticle.
Multishot and Punch Through can generate more stacks.
Stacks are expended once the attack connects with an enemy. Attacks with multiple hits or connecting with multiple enemies will only consume 1 stack.

Acquisition
Vinquibus' main and component blueprints are obtained from Roathe's Oblivion on Infernium 21 of The Descendia, available after completing The Old Peace quest.
Alternatively Vinquibus's blueprints can be purchased from Roathe in La Cathėdrale, Sanctum Anatomica for  Maphica obtained in The Descendia. Each component blueprint requires 25 and the main blueprint requires 35, totaling 135 Maphica for the whole set.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Crafting
Vinquibus's materials are obtained from The Perita Rebellion. A total of 2,500  Agnovidisc, 1,330  Laudavi, and 430  Servoris are needed to craft all parts.

Notes
When  Disarmed of the Vinquibus, the player will only drop the primary form, but is still capable of using the melee form.
It is NOT advised to use the  Umbra Forma on the Vinquibus, as polarities are shared between forms, unless the weapon has been polarized enough times. Since there are no  Mods for Primary Weapons, it cannot benefit from reducing capacity drain on Vinquibus' Primary mode.
The Vinquibus cannot be used in Melee Only missions, such as the Anniversary Alerts.
Renaming the Vinquibus through any open world weapons provider will only rename the Primary or Melee depending on which one you choose to rename. So it would cost 30 Platinum instead of 15 to rename both

Trivia
When reloading from empty, the Vinquibus produces a distinct "ping" sound as the old magazine is ejected, akin to the famous M1 Garand rifle used in World War 2.
It is the second weapon to be named after the real-life Arquebus, the first being the  Voidrig's  Arquebex.
